independence_control.controlled_summary: Gil expressly said he was not alleging pressure or interference had already occurred at ICALPA. He identified a preventive structural-risk hypothesis and requested reinforced safeguards for ponente independence, confidentiality, formal traceability, logging of external approaches, and abstention/substitution or other protective measures if an incident affecting impartiality arose.
short_source_extracts: riesgo objetivo de presión estructural y necesidad de proteger al ponente
aproximaciones informales ... llamadas de terceros ... contactos no procedimentales
máxima apariencia y realidad de independencia, confidencialidad, trazabilidad y no interferencia
